fieldValues.title: Maintainer in Checkable AI documents
fieldValues.summary: The secretary, organiser or analyst who runs the process over new sources, supplies facts and corrections, accepts or dismisses what the process flags, and publishes.
goals: a trustworthy document with little editing
keep it current as new sources arrive
every correction traceable to who made it and why
change model or tool without losing consistency
jobs: run the process over a new transcript or source
accept or dismiss flags and proposals
reshape the document's map when the work changes
publish a readable version with private material withheld
fieldValues.needs: Every kind of change available as a repeatable, checked step; history brought to each run without reading it all; few, good flags; the published copy scrubbed by rule.
